noor-kitchen.name: Noor's kitchen (Utrecht-Oost)
noor-kitchen.description: A small, cosy, lived-in kitchen in a Dutch city flat, seen from the doorway so that both side walls show. Centre and right: a large window with a white frame, three potted herbs on the sill and red-brick terraced houses across the street; directly in front of the window a small square light-wood table with exactly two wooden chairs facing each other and a bowl of apples in the middle. Left wall: a run of sage-green lower cabinets with round brass knobs under a light-wood worktop, white square wall tiles, a two-ring electric hob with a small saucepan, a stainless-steel sink with a dish rack, a bread board with half a loaf, an electric kettle and a small black coffee machine. Above the worktop one open wooden shelf with a row of mismatched mugs, plain unlabelled glass jars and a stack of plates, and below it a rail with a ladle, a whisk and a tea towel. Beside the cabinets a narrow white fridge with a few round magnets. Pale cream walls, a small round wall clock above the doorway, a light terracotta floor, warm morning light.

sofia-office.name: Sofia's office (small IT company near Utrecht Centraal)
sofia-office.description: A small, bright open-plan office of a small IT company on an upper floor, seen from the entrance. Along a row of large windows on the right: four light-wood desks pushed together in pairs, each with one monitor, a keyboard and a black office chair; the front-left desk is very tidy with a closed laptop and a paper agenda, the desk next to it has a mug and a small plant. Through the windows: the modern glass roof of a big railway station and rows of parked bicycles below. Left wall: a sage-green wall with a whiteboard with a few coloured boxes and arrows (no words), a coat rack with a bike helmet on it, and a tall plant. Light-grey floor, white ceiling lamps, warm daylight.

sofia-living-room.name: Sofia's living room (Kastanjestraat 14, second floor)
sofia-living-room.description: A big, light living room on the second floor of an older Dutch brick building, seen from the doorway. Back wall: a wide window with a white frame and, to its right, a glass door to a small balcony; red-brick houses and autumn trees across the street. In front of the window a small round light-wood dining table with two chairs and a round pendant lamp hanging above it. Left: a dusty-blue three-seater sofa standing with its back towards the left wall, facing the window, a tall floor lamp right next to the sofa, and a large round mirror hanging on the wall above it. Right: the room's door, open, with a small grey bin just behind it, and an empty corner with bare white walls. Light oak floorboards, white walls, warm daylight.

kanaalstraat.name: Kanaalstraat, Lombok (Utrecht)
kanaalstraat.description: A lively, narrow multicultural shopping street in Lombok, Utrecht, seen along its length at street level. Both sides: two- and three-storey brown and red-brick buildings with shops at street level: on the left a bakery with bread in the window and next to it a small supermarket with fruit and vegetable crates outside; on the right a pharmacy with a green cross, a bike shop with bikes outside, and a bus stop shelter opposite the supermarket. Shop fronts have plain coloured awnings and boards with simple pictograms only. Many bicycles parked against the walls, a few cyclists, narrow pavements, small street trees with yellow autumn leaves. At the far end of the street, rising above the roofs: a big white mosque with a dome and one tall slender minaret. Soft autumn sunlight, blue sky with a few clouds.
